description:
LanguageTool is a localization productivity app for developers and product teams.
``
Key features:
• Process iOS .strings and .xcstrings files
• Process Flutter .arb files
• Process Electron .json files
• AI-assisted batch translation into 50+ languages
• Review translations before export
• Optionally skip existing translations to avoid overwrites
• Export results and sync back to source files
``
Best for:
• Shipping multilingual releases faster
• Expanding language coverage on existing products
• Unifying localization workflows across platforms
``
LanguageTool reduces repetitive manual work and makes localization delivery faster and more reliable.
promotionalText: Batch-translate and export iOS, Flutter, and Electron localization files. Preserve existing translations and ship multilingual updates faster.
